negative_results: Unblinding before the acquired data are locked is refused (peeking): refuse_unblind_before_lock raises.
A wrong or tampered sealed commitment reveals nothing: unblind re-raises the commitment mismatch as BlindingError.
An analyst, operator, or auditor has no unblinding authority: refuse_unauthorized_unblind raises for any role outside {CUSTODIAN, UNBLINDER}.
An exploratory run cannot be relabelled confirmatory after the fact: refuse_relabel_confirmatory raises.
A broken blind (accidental disclosure or emergency unblind) downgrades the affected run's evidence from E6 blinded support to the E1 exploratory floor.
Nothing is measured: every label, facet, and dataset is a synthetic fixture; no physical validation is claimed and there is no PHRYLL_DETECTED state.
reopening_test: This phase reopens if an operator packet or UI payload contains a real assignment value; if an unblind succeeds without an authorized role, a locked dataset, and the exact sealed commitment; if a broken blind is not logged or does not downgrade the affected run's evidence; or if an exploratory run can be relabelled confirmatory.
acceptance_checklist: r15/blinding.py implements OPERATOR/CUSTODIAN/ANALYST/AUDITOR/UNBLINDER roles, masked run packets and UI payloads, a lock-gated unblind, accidental-disclosure and emergency-unblind logging with evidence downgrade, and exploratory/confirmatory separation.
Reuses r13.preregister, r13.holdout, r13.serialize and r15.claims; no sibling R15 phase module is imported.
Operator payload contains no assignment (required test passes).
Analyst cannot unblind without authority (required test passes).
Emergency unblinding is logged and downgrades evidence (required test passes).
Exploratory runs cannot be relabelled confirmatory (required test passes).
Focused, negative, and determinism tests pass: tests/v8/test_blinding.py, 25 tests green.
Receipt conforms to phase_receipt.schema.json (validated with jsonschema); privacy scan clean.

claims.claim_cap: The strongest class this phase produces is SOFTWARE_IMPLEMENTED. Blinding is a statement about what the operator can see and when the blind may be lifted; it measures nothing and claims no physical validation.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
